messages.text: Hi, when i want b30 in price 899usd is included vat & customs if it will be shipped to Slovakia. Because base on information on your site its not clear for me
Handed to the team · Cannot confirm the ship-from warehouse for the B30 on an EU order, so cannot sta

The $899 is the unit price only. Our prices are listed in USD and exclude VAT, and checkout does not collect import VAT, it only calculates shipping from your address.

What decides it for Slovakia is which warehouse your B30 ships from. If it goes out of our Netherlands warehouse, there is nothing extra to pay on delivery. If it ships from outside the EU, the carrier collects 21% import VAT plus any duty from you.

I don't want to guess on the B30, so I've put that question to Georges. The team is offline until 10am ET today, and the answer comes to (email hidden)
Ok i hope some one will explain

They will, Georges has it and picks it up at 10am ET today, by email.

In the meantime, anything else about the B30 I can answer? Specs, power draw at the wall, noise, or what it would stack at Slovak electricity prices. Happy to run those numbers for you.
Power draw on wall with th/s please

The B30 has three modes, measured at the wall:

Turbo, 30 TH/s at 485 W, 16.2 J/TH.
Balanced, 24 TH/s at 350 W, 14.6 J/TH.
ECO, 18 TH/s at 230 W, 12.8 J/TH.

Power supply is 540 W built in, 100 to 240 V, so it runs fine on Slovak 230 V. Noise is around 50 dB in all modes.

Most people at European electricity prices run Balanced or ECO. Want me to run the sats and power cost for Slovakia? If you tell me your rate per kWh I'll use the real one.
